method: Reviewed all 12 stills in a contact sheet, inspected shed/passage/south photographs at larger size, and iterated Blender inspection renders. Approximate poses; no photogrammetric solve.

photos.finding: Road-to-garden stair breaks, shed relationship to measured trunks, and upper route grade need a multi-view fit.
Shed full-width doors, horizontal board courses, shallow shingled roof, front rake trim and Pooles plaque.
Final descent context reviewed; retain owner-positioned 19-step approach. Uneven individual risers remain unresolved.
photos.followUp96: Owner-selected root images copy establishes upper south deck taper toward the water.

photos.finding: Door recess already modeled; utility meter, conduit and entrance bench remain absent.
East passage block colour variation and softened edges; retain current metal roof rather than the historical covering.
photos.followUp99: Owner-confirmed wall/hillside reference: course profile, local bank, brush and stump/root mass now modeled.

photos.finding: Open U-shaped tree notch and inward railing returns; geometry follows existing tree anchor, dimensions estimated.
Cross-check pale fascia and weathered timber against the north view.
Pale fascia around current metal roof and weathered deck timber.
Underside joists, retaining corner and lower deck connections need refinement.
Six-panel green storage door, threshold, flanking boards and stepped retaining edge beside beach stairs.
photos.followUp95: Used to correct door location and connected lower enclosure; compare.html now uses owner south camera.

photos.finding: Stair/deck proportions and underdeck support layout need reconciliation with the other south views.
Cross-check storage door under south deck, retaining tiers, fascia and timber against the wider beach view.
photos.followUp95: Used to correct door location and connected lower enclosure; compare.html now uses owner south camera.

videoFrames.034: Individual board UV samples and shed-side branch reference.
videoFrames.047: Paving texture and local surface/planting context only. Owner correction: the 22-25 second camera pan does not establish a physical dogleg.

remaining: Upper approach slope is still a coarse lidar-based profile; photographic stair breaks are not solved.
Shed absolute dimensions, pose and unseen support arrangement remain estimates.
Bank cuts remain visibly angular and the east wall profile requires fitting.
Deck proportions, underside framing and individual stair dimensions need additional view-by-view work.
inspection: Blender renders show authored structures and cleared terrain context. Deck comparisons include the same sparse front-tree shape used in the app; surrounding app trees, sky and live scene are omitted. Source images and render PNGs remain local.
routeCorrection: 2026-09-14: removed false pair of right-angle turns; continuous westward curve meets the retained stair head. Camera-pan frames excluded from route direction evidence. Geographic curve and side-pad placement remain estimates.

greenDoorCorrection.finding: Owner south camera comparison shows green door in the first seaward bay under the lower south deck; previous placement was about three metres too far uphill. Corrected door/frame, enclosure return and lattice, apron/rock support and terrain clearance.
greenDoorCorrection.limits: Dimensions and rock shelf are visual estimates. Camera uses supplied coordinates/FOV, not a recovered photo pose. Roof, deck levels and approach controls retained.

upperDeckCorrection.finding: South return widens westward; tree sits in an open U-shaped notch, with railing and framing following the opening.
upperDeckCorrection.limits: Estimated dimensions at existing site tree anchor; no camera solve.

shallowTreeNotchCorrection.finding: Tree barely inside the seaward edge; previous fixed site-tree anchor was too far inland and caused an oversized 3.15m notch. Runtime tree moved west, notch reduced to estimated 0.83m, deck restored.
shallowTreeNotchCorrection.limits: Estimated centre 0.15m inside edge; no new survey.

deckWidthTreeCorrection.finding: Narrowed westward deck projections to upper 2.40m and lower 2.10m; moved full-width green-door bay and supports with the rim. Front tree has a 6-degree seaward lean, exposed irregular forked branches and 16 small foliage clusters. Trunk at deck height remains 0.15m inside the edge and the notch remains 0.83m deep.
deckWidthTreeCorrection.limits: Visual estimates; original lidar tree height retained. Branches approximate the sparse silhouette, not individually surveyed. Inspection camera is not solved.

eastWallCorrection.finding: Owner confirms wall and hillside accuracy despite historical cabin. Replaced lidar-height towers with complete staggered courses and gentler setback; added local bank soil, sparse brush/grass and pale split stump/root mass. Existing cabin, passage boards and stair meshes preserved.
eastWallCorrection.limits: Visual estimates: 0.40m blocks, 0.20m courses, 0.025m setback; 8/9/10 courses. Local bank is scenic geometry, not a new survey or fitted walking surface. Inspection camera is approximate.

stairEastCorrection.finding: Complementary east-facing stair-base view: broad decayed stump with exposed core instead of upright log; wall return and soil lip adjoining stair; leafy growth and lower north rail; weathered concrete/timber.
stairEastCorrection.limits: Photo-guided estimates; original 19 tread/riser planes and stair controls preserved. Bank remains scenic geometry, not surveyed walking terrain. Approximate inspection camera.
